classification_coverage_user_decision.instruction: 允许用现有 SoM 二分类满足分类覆盖
classification_coverage_user_decision.original_difference: The existing nine ExpansionRx endpoints are continuous regressions; no new thresholded ADMET labels are introduced.

source_roles.molecule_group: full source InChIKey from byte-bound native membership metadata; require an explicit source-member-to-group map
source_roles.fit_group_overlap_rule: Exclude optimization members whose full molecule group occurs in the original inner-validation population; preserve original role files and report exclusions.

selection.algorithm: sort unique molecule groups by SHA256([seed,dataset,group]); retain first cap groups; retain every native member/isoform/atom belonging to each selected group

source_roles.membership_freeze: Persist selected native member IDs, molecule groups, source bindings and hashes outside Git before encoding any checkpoint. A different membership requires a new panel version.

ridge.selection: smallest mean molecular inner-CV error; smaller alpha breaks exact ties
ridge.feature_and_target_normalization: fit each optimization fold only; refit on optimization population for inner-validation prediction
ridge.unavailable_fold_metric: report unavailable and do not silently omit the fold

linear64_relu.selection: fixed final endpoint; no early stopping
linear64_relu.atom_loss: BCE with logits on native observed candidate masks

readouts.pooling_note: The source-aligned development readout uses its fixed mean pooling for all graph endpoints, including U0. This is separate from registry-defined pretraining-head pooling comparisons.

reference.primary: same architecture, same native membership, same readout recipe and readout seed, random encoder initialization seed 20261025
reference.historical_s_B3: descriptive sanity reference only; use a matching 384x4 random reference, never the 512x6 random reference

aggregation.primary: equal mean of all 18 task-by-readout normalized improvements
mandatory_separate_reports: nine task rows for each readout
aggregation.missing_or_zero_reference_error: explicit unavailable; no complete panel score and no architecture decision

uncertainty.bootstrap_unit: full source molecule group; group all native rows and isoforms together
uncertainty.seed_SD: sample SD with ddof=1 from exactly two pretraining seeds of the same seed-excluded scientific configuration

operating_rules.cache: target-free frozen native atom H0 once per encoder/geometry/membership binding, outside Git
operating_rules.wandb: persistent offline or online with explicit committed history; preserve unsynced SDK files

pending_physical_bindings: complete frozen downstream store manifest and SHA
selected TRAIN/inner-validation membership artifact and SHA
one actual candidate checkpoint and matching random encoder
actual runtime and W&B closure evidence
